distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Jiangxi, including Long Nan. Smith et al. (2022) adds Yunnan, with locality evidence from Xishuangbanna. The reviewed current distribution is the union Jiangxi + Yunnan.

host_note: No confirmed host is reported in either integrated Smith record; no host is promoted.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Leptoxyleborus machili (Niisima, 1910).
